title: STS coverage
intro: No console page: a session is used from a CLI or a tool, so every row is
outside the console by design, not waiting on it.
The gateway forwards STS like any other global service, so `get-caller-identity`
against it answers the account the key was issued for.
`GetAccessKeyInfo` and `GetWebIdentityToken` are implemented by the emulator and
absent from its README row; `tests/control/test_sts.py` exercises both. The trust
policy behind the two AssumeRole paths is only evaluated with `AUTH=true`, so the
lab matrix proves that decision, not this suite.

not_console.GetCallerIdentity: not a console action (a session is used from a CLI or a tool)
not_console.AssumeRole: not a console action (a session is used from a CLI or a tool)
not_console.GetSessionToken: not a console action (a session is used from a CLI or a tool)
not_console.GetFederationToken: not a console action (a session is used from a CLI or a tool)
not_console.AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity: not a console action (a session is used from a CLI or a tool)
